g.text: Examples of the three allowed interior counts
These are examples from the same 19-point configuration, not separate solutions.
Blue: chosen convex hexagon Orange: its interior points Faint dots: other inner points
The three outer points are outside every displayed hexagon and are omitted from these enlarged views.
Some angles and interior gaps are extremely small; inclusion and strict convexity are certified exactly, not inferred from the drawing.
